text:
Tanya: dropped a compact mock for inline edit + approval flow on diffs — figma://redwood/inline-diff-edit (quick screenshot pasted). want design + a11y nits before we hand to eng.
Omar: Nice direction. main UX question: when you inline-edit a diff note, do we autosave draft or require explicit Save? prefer explicit Save with an undo toast.
Liu: Accessibility: ensure the inline edit becomes a proper dialog for screen readers (role=dialog) so focus is trapped and form labels read. For simple inline edits, at least move focus to the first input and announce "Editing note for <test-name>" via aria-live.
Carla: Copy nudge: action verbs should be consistent. Instead of "Mark fixed" use "Mark as fixed". For resolved diffs use "No regression detected" not "OK". Also the approval CTA should read "Approve fix" rather than "Approve" to clarify context.
Ben: Visual: when a diff row is in edit mode, apply a 2px left accent and a subtle surface elevation. Also show a tiny cancel icon that appears on hover only (avoid clutter).
Tanya: Good. For save behavior I'll prototype explicit Save + keyboard shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter). Add a small "Draft saved" microcopy for autosave fallback if we implement it later.
Omar: Keyboard: Esc cancels edit, Enter inside text area should insert newline; Save must be bound to Ctrl/Cmd+Enter and there should be a visible hint near the field. For list navigation support up/down to move between diffs when not editing.
Liu: Screen reader specifics: when saved announce "Note saved for <test-name>". When approved announce "Diff approved and flagged as resolved". Also add role=button to the inline approve control with aria-pressed state.
Carla: Approval flow UX: if user approves a diff that has unresolved comments, show a small modal explaining there are unresolved threads and offer two choices: Approve anyway / View unresolved. Keep modal keyboard-friendly and labelled.
Ben: Mobile: make the edit field full-screen modal on small viewports to avoid cramped text entry. Use large tap targets and ensure the Save button floats above the keyboard (avoid being covered).
Tanya: Integration: deep-linking is important — add a per-diff permalink icon that copies a URL with a hash linking to the diff and opens the detail view in scorecard. "Open in scorecard" should anchor the relevant eval row.
Omar: Performance/UX: when toggling inline edit, avoid layout shifts. animate opacity + translateY 40ms. respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Liu: Contrast checks: the left accent color and the inline action badges must pass 4.5:1 against the panel background when used as primary indicators. If not possible, use bold icons + labels.
Carla: Microcopy: the approve confirmation toast should include an undo action for 6s: "Approved — Undo". For bulk approvals show a compact summary like "3 diffs approved (2 critical)".
Ben: Edge case: concurrent edits — show a small warning if someone else edited the same note in the last 30s and give options to overwrite or merge. Show a diff of the note changes in the modal.
EvalBot: automated: eval run 1999 attached. summary: 14 diffs, 5 regressions. backend PR #488 will expose per-diff permalinks and approval flags.
Tanya: OK i'll update Figma with the explicit Save flow, keyboard hints, and the approval modal copy. i'll also add aria snippets for the dialog and live announcements. Posting PR by tomorrow morning. Ping if you want to pair on the concurrent-edit UX. :sparkles:
